description: Observe the real abandonment confirmation and its ten second countdown.

FIXTURE: replace spawned home silver with an explicit 0..20000 balance to test insufficient/exact payment; does not change bank records.

FIXTURE: create six ordinary game items with non-default quality, durability, taint, ingredients, rot, color and fuel for real trade transfer tests.
FIXTURE: give one colonist representative enabled-DLC state using game APIs. Does not emulate earning titles, surgery, rituals or resurrection.
FIXTURE: construct a fueled researched ship, board all three colonists and move silver/steel onto it; no launch/settlement callbacks or controller state are injected.
FIXTURE: kill the pawn of one active hired contract through Pawn.Kill; the real death notification creates any debt.

FIXTURE: add/remove one hostile mech on an existing destination map to test settle threat validation.
FIXTURE: destroy one steel stack on an active remote map, exercising ordinary destruction callbacks; no server or home map writes.
FIXTURE: kill one active borrowed pawn through the game's death path; requires explicit acknowledgement.
FIXTURE: advance one active temporary support quest deadline to the next game tick; does not run or complete the quest.
